scope: Reference-guided method icon candidates; design review, not shipped Android assets

methods.name: Chemex
methods.geometry_brief: Glass hourglass body: broad open conical top, narrow waist with a wooden collar and leather tie, rounded lower carafe, and a visible pour-spout channel. Use the Classic's handle-free silhouette.
methods.exclude: No loop handle, separate cone, mechanical valve, plunger, paper packaging, or added mug.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Hourglass body, wooden collar, leather tie and pour channel; Classic has no loop handle.

methods.name: Automatic drip
methods.geometry_brief: Complete automatic filter machine: tall left heater column and clear water reservoir above it, short shower arm extending to the right filter basket, glass carafe directly below that basket, and a shared low rectangular base. Simplify hardware while retaining this unmistakable arrangement.
methods.exclude: No portafilter, steam wand, bean hopper, espresso group head, separate kettle, or extra cups.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Reservoir/heater column, right filter basket, carafe beneath and shared base; no espresso hardware.

methods.name: NextLevel Pulsar
methods.geometry_brief: Straight clear cylindrical brewing chamber, broad flat black shower cap on top, sturdy black footed base, and the small external flow-control lever at the side of the base. Clearly retain the shower cap, chamber and valve as distinct parts.
methods.exclude: No cone, loop handle, piston, plunger rod, carafe, or curved glass hourglass.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Straight chamber, footed base and side valve. Refined the exaggerated metallic outlets into a shallow clear shower distributor.

methods.name: Hario V60
methods.geometry_brief: Open circular cone narrowing toward a single bottom outlet, characteristic spiral ribs, small loop handle on the right, and a flat circular support flange. Match the photographed V60 02 geometry; omit its box.
methods.exclude: No wedge-shaped flat seam, chunky valve base, Switch lever, plunger, packaging or brand marks.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Circular pointed cone, spiral ribs, loop handle and circular support flange.

methods.name: Clever Dripper
methods.reference_selection_note: Manufacturer home-image candidate was visually blank and rejected; select the roaster published guide photograph instead.
methods.geometry_brief: Broad tapered wedge-shaped brewing chamber with a wide opening, large curved right-side handle, broad circular release base and short feet. Isolate the Clever from the brewing photograph. Show an open rim with a simple ivory paper filter, and preserve its chamber-to-release-base proportion.
methods.exclude: No pouring kettle, water stream, table, serving carafe, logos, spiral V60 cone, or external Switch lever. Do not invent a lid or screw insert.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Wide tapered chamber, large handle and release base with feet; front boss follows the photograph without branding.

methods.name: Hario Switch
methods.geometry_brief: Ribbed glass V60 cone seated in a substantial dark flared silicone valve base, with its external transparent switch lever visibly projecting from the side. The photographed glass cone has no loop handle. Retain the heavier valve base and lever so this cannot read as a plain V60.
methods.exclude: No V60 loop handle, wooden collar, plunger, flat shower lid, mug, or packaging.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Glass cone, substantial valve base and side lever; no V60 loop handle.

methods.name: Kalita Wave
methods.geometry_brief: Broad shallow truncated stainless-steel cone with a flat lower floor, horizontal stepped bands, a low round support flange and small right-side loop handle. Keep the wide shallow bowl shape, rather than a pointed V60 cone.
methods.exclude: No spiral ribs, conical pointed bottom, valve lever, plunger, lid, or mug.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Shallow broad bowl, horizontal bands and flat lower floor; distinct from the V60.

methods.name: Melitta style pour-over
methods.geometry_brief: Wide oval opening tapering into a wedge body with a short flat bottom seam, straight vertical interior ribs, right-side loop handle, and broad round support flange. Follow the unboxed 1x4 photograph, including the low front viewing opening at the flange. Keep the wedge visibly different from the circular spiral V60.
methods.exclude: No spiral ribs, circular pointed cone, mechanical valve, packaging, printed brand, or numbers.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Oval opening, wedge body, straight ribs and low viewing opening. Refined the framing to preserve the entire handle.

methods.name: Turkish coffee
methods.model: Soy C1 cezve; representative long-handle pot
methods.geometry_brief: One small copper cezve with a rounded wider lower body, narrower neck, open flared mouth and a very long slim handle rising diagonally to the right. Preserve the full handle and its attachment from the photo; simplify hammered detail into a few soft copper highlights.
methods.exclude: No lid, side loop handle, moka chambers, flame, stove, coffee cup, or steam.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Open narrow-neck copper pot with a complete long rising handle.

methods.name: Vietnamese phin
methods.reference_selection_note: Maker exploded-parts photograph: assembled icon must use gravity insert, not a threaded screw or an espresso portafilter.
methods.geometry_brief: One assembled Vietnamese gravity phin: short wide cylindrical metal chamber, small side loop handle, shallow fitted cap, and a broad flat perforated support plate below. The exploded photograph supplies the component shapes; assemble the pieces in their real order. The gravity insert rests inside and is hidden beneath the fitted lid.
methods.exclude: No exploded arrangement, arrows, labels, threaded screw or long piston rod, espresso handle, cup, or extra loose pieces.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Assembled short metal chamber, fitted cap, side handle and broad support plate; gravity insert remains hidden inside.

methods.name: French press
methods.reference_selection_note: Manufacturer page returned403; original roaster product photograph for the same Bodum model is used.
methods.geometry_brief: Cylindrical glass jug in a simple metal frame, curved black side handle, short pour spout, domed lid, round plunger knob and central straight rod leading to a visible mesh disc inside the jug. Use the Chambord photograph's silhouette and support feet.
methods.exclude: No V60 cone, separate filter basket, extra mug, kettle, printed markings, or steam.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Glass cylinder, frame, side handle, plunger rod and disc; no separate brewing cone.

methods.name: AeroPress
methods.geometry_brief: One assembled upright AeroPress Original: dark translucent straight brewing chamber, piston emerging at the top with a broad flat top flange, broad lower support flange and standard filter cap at the bottom. Show a modest extension of the piston so the two overlapping cylinders are clear. Isolate only the brewer from the product photograph.
methods.exclude: No mug, scoop, stirrer, printed numbers, logos, side handle, long French-press rod, flow-control valve, or inverted position.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Upright overlapping cylinders, extended piston, flanges and standard lower filter cap.

methods.name: Espresso
methods.geometry_brief: One compact Bambino Plus-style espresso machine: tall rounded rectangular body, clean small circular front controls, portafilter locked under the brew group with its black handle clearly projecting forward, right-side steam wand, and drip tray beneath an open brewing area. Preserve the photographed group-to-tray and wand arrangement.
methods.exclude: No integrated grinder, bean hopper, pressure gauge, extra cups, printed control labels, or automatic-drip basket and carafe.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Compact machine, projecting locked portafilter, right steam wand and drip tray; no grinder or hopper.

methods.name: Moka pot
methods.geometry_brief: Complete closed Moka Express: octagonal lower water chamber, screw-joint waist, octagonal upper collecting chamber with a left pour spout, hinged sloping lid and black knob, large black curved handle on the right, and a small safety valve on the lower chamber. Retain the distinctive two-chamber octagonal silhouette.
methods.exclude: No flames, stove, coffee cup, glass hourglass, percolator cylinder, steam, pressure gauge, or logo.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Octagonal upper and lower chambers, joint, lid, knob, spout, handle and lower safety valve.

methods.name: Cold brew
methods.model: Generic covered glass vessel; no integral filter implied
methods.reference_selection_note: Jar anatomy only. Generic unbranded covered vessel; photo is not a batch capacity or a brewing procedure. No built-in filter or ice.
methods.geometry_brief: One generic covered wide-mouth glass steeping jar with a simple screw lid, rounded shoulders, broad cylindrical body, and dark coffee-colored contents well below the lid. Use the single jar at the right of the photo for jar anatomy. Omit all embossing; show a little dark ground-coffee sediment at the bottom to suggest immersion brewing.
methods.exclude: No retail carton, cluster of jars, embossed lettering, measuring marks, integral filter basket, ice, straw, serving tumbler, spigot, or capacity claim.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Generic covered steeping jar with coffee-colored contents and sediment. No integral filter, ice or batch capacity implied.

methods.name: Siphon
methods.geometry_brief: A complete Hario Technica-style siphon: upper straight glass brewing cylinder, descending central glass tube into the round lower globe, gasket at the joined neck, metal stand with a right-side handle supporting the globe, stable base and unlit alcohol lamp centered underneath the globe. Preserve the real joined two-chamber arrangement and stable support.
methods.exclude: No floating disconnected chambers, invented plumbing, pressure gauge, steampunk gear, flame, boiling liquid, coffee cup, or lettering.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Joined glass cylinder and globe, stable stand and unlit lamp. Refined the upper filter location, stem hook and branding-derived false stopper.

methods.name: Percolator
methods.geometry_brief: One electric percolator with a tall gently tapered cylindrical metal pot, fitted lid and black knob, long raised pouring spout on the left, black curved handle on the right, and a low black electric base. Match the photographed Presto silhouette; simplify tiny details.
methods.exclude: No cord, serving cup, saucer, branding, moka octagons, glass French-press chamber or plunger, tea infuser, or steam.
methods.reference_review: Visually inspected; selected for equipment anatomy
methods.visual_review_note: Tall cylindrical pot, fitted lid, long spout, handle and electric base; no moka chambers or plunger.
